_comment: Maps a retrieved slide's source filename (as indexed in the knowledge base's
slides collection, the 'source_file' / 'filename' of each deck) to the lecture
number of the lecture plan and the rendered decks (learning_goals.json
'lecture', output/<course>/lecture-NN). Your original decks may be named or
numbered differently from the plan; this file says which lecture each one
teaches, so a slide hit can move the chat's slide panel to the right deck.
Rules: 'map' pairs a source with exactly one lecture. 'unmapped' lists sources
that deliberately have no deck (review sessions, exam feedback): the panel
stays where it is. Matching is by exact filename, then case-insensitive stem,
